blocks.text: CEBU CITY — A late-night fire destroyed a commercial establishment, a bar, along Gen. Maxilom Ave., formerly Mango Ave., in Barangay Kamputhaw, Cebu City, on Wednesday night, Nov. 25, 2026. Fire investigators said the one-and-a-half-hour blaze left an estimated ₱18 million in property damage. According to a report from the Cebu City Fire Station, the fire broke out at Jane’s KTV Bar, an establishment owned by Susan King and occupied by Erik Labao and nine other individuals. READ: Brgy.
